data.base_prompt: Animate the authorized adult portrait into a seven-second vertical alternate-world micro-story. Preserve facial identity, age, skin tone, hairstyle, clothing silhouette and body proportions. Use one soft blink, a small natural head turn, subtle breathing and gentle environmental motion. The camera performs a restrained cinematic push-in. A soft light boundary changes only the environment into {{WORLD_DESCRIPTION}}. Keep face, hands and clothing stable. End in a pose and framing close to the opening frame for a seamless loop.

route_variables.Cinematic: an independent-film city street at blue hour, realistic practical lights, subtle wet pavement reflections, no logos
route_variables.Dreamlike: a quiet miniature cloud garden with soft floating seeds and believable depth, poetic but not cartoon-like
route_variables.Retro Memory: a sun-faded 1990s summer street with warm natural flare and restrained film grain, no brand or franchise references

data.negative_prompt: identity change, face swap, age change, skin-tone change, gender change, beauty retouching, extra fingers, deformed hands, lip-sync, exaggerated expression, violent camera shake, flicker, melting background, text, logo, copyrighted character, celebrity likeness, abrupt final frame

fallbacks.action: block and request a single-person portrait
reduce stylization to 0.25 and motion to 0.2; retry once
crop to chest-up framing or regenerate with hands out of frame
replace final 0.6s with a stabilized hold and crossfade
